prompt.zh-TW: 美琪第一次看山谷民宿的現金流量表（間接法）。營業活動那一段的第一列，是從哪個數字開始往下調整的？
prompt.en: Mei is reading Valley Guesthouse’s statement of cash flows (indirect method) for the first time. Which figure does the first line of the operating section start from before the adjustments?

text.en: Profit before tax from the income statement

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。間接法從損益表的利益出發，再一步步調整成現金。
feedback.en: Nice work. The indirect method starts from the profit on the income statement and adjusts it step by step into cash.

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道起點來自損益表，這點沒錯。不過間接法不是從最上面的收入重算一遍，而是從已經算好的利益出發，只調整利益和現金不同的地方。
feedback.en: You know the starting point comes from the income statement, which is right. But the indirect method does not recompute everything from revenue at the top; it starts from the profit already worked out and adjusts only where profit and cash differ.

feedback.zh-TW: 現金流量表上確實有期初現金這一列，這點沒錯。不過它在表的最下面，用來和現金的增減額加總出期末現金；營業活動那一段是從利益開始調整的。
feedback.en: The statement does have an opening cash line, that much is right. But it sits at the bottom, where it is added to the net change to give closing cash; the operating section starts its adjustments from profit.

explanation.zh-TW: 間接法的想法是「利益已經算好了，只要修正利益和現金不一樣的地方」。課程模板從{{term:tm_z971merj}}起算，所以答案是{{option:o_te8a}}；若從本期淨利起算，需另加回所得稅費用，最後的營業活動現金流量相同。從{{option:o_v70d}}開始等於從頭重算；{{option:o_3rkf}}放在表的最後面，是用來推出期末現金的。
explanation.en: The idea of the indirect method is that profit is already worked out, so only the places where profit and cash differ need correcting. This course’s template starts from {{term:tm_z971merj}}, so the answer is {{option:o_te8a}}; if you start from profit for the period instead, income tax expense has to be added back as well, and net cash from operating activities comes out the same. Starting from {{option:o_v70d}} would mean recomputing from the top, and {{option:o_3rkf}} sits at the foot of the statement, where it is used to arrive at closing cash.
